description: Transcripts of public YouTube videos, channels and playlists, plus YouTube search, for ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.longDescription: BulkTranscripts gets the transcript of public YouTube videos that have captions, so ChatGPT can summarise them, answer questions about them or quote them with timestamps. Paste a video link, or name a channel or playlist, and it returns clean transcript text with the title, channel, duration and upload date, up to 20 videos per request. For a whole channel or playlist (up to 1,000 videos) it runs a background job that collects every transcript into your library and reports progress as it goes. You can also search YouTube for videos, channels or playlists, search inside one channel for a topic, and see what a channel has uploaded recently. Useful for podcasts, lectures, courses, interviews and research. Transcripts already in your library can be read again at any time. Sign in with your BulkTranscripts account to connect.
defaultPrompt: Summarise the key points of this YouTube video
Get the transcripts of this playlist and list the main topics
